telecom_knowledge.abbreviation_map:
Telecom Abbreviation Reference — expand these when renaming:
- aon         → AgeOnNetwork
- mou         → Mou (keep as Mou — do NOT expand to MinutesOfUse)
- arpu        → Arpu (keep as Arpu — widely understood)
- rev         → Revenue
- cnt         → Count
- amt         → Amount
- vol         → Volume
- avg         → Avg
- msisdn      → Msisdn (identifier — keep recognizable)
- imsi        → Imsi (identifier — keep recognizable)
- cust        → Customer
- acct        → Account
- seg         → Segment
- flg / flag  → Flag
- ind         → Flag
- dt          → Date
- mnth / mth  → Month
- wk          → Week
- l30d        → Last30d
- l60d        → Last60d
- l90d        → Last90d
- p30d        → Prev30d
- rchg        → Recharge
- tot / ttl   → Total
- out / outg  → Outgoing
- inc / incmg → Incoming
- intl        → Intl
- roam        → Roaming
- vas         → Vas (keep as Vas — industry standard)
- gprs        → Data
- offnet      → Offnet
- onnet       → Onnet
- comp        → Complaint
- cc          → CustCare
- gndr        → Gender
- rgn         → Region
- actv        → Activation
- deactv      → Deactivation
- dob         → BirthDate
- hva         → HighValue
- mva         → MidValue
- lva         → LowValue
- sms         → Sms (keep as Sms)
- clv / ltv   → Ltv
- pkg / pack  → Plan
- contract    → ContractType
- tenure      → Tenure
telecom_knowledge.unit_rules:
Unit Suffix Rules — read carefully, these are strict:

NEVER add a unit suffix to:
- Mou columns → Mou already implies minutes. NEVER append Mins. Ever.
  CORRECT: MouOutgoingLast30d
  WRONG:   MouOutgoingLast30dMins
- AgeOnNetwork → days is the telecom default. NEVER append Days.
  CORRECT: AgeOnNetwork
  WRONG:   AgeOnNetworkDays
- Arpu → currency is implied. No suffix.
- Revenue columns → currency is implied. No suffix.
- Recharge amount columns → currency is implied. No suffix.
- Count columns → Count suffix is enough. No unit needed.
- Flag columns → binary, no unit.

ALWAYS add a unit suffix to these — unit is genuinely ambiguous:
- Data/Gprs/Vol columns: infer unit from max value in df.describe:
    max > 1,000,000   → append Bytes
    max 10k–1,000,000 → append Kb
    max 1,000–10,000  → append Mb
    max < 1,000       → append Gb
  CORRECT: DataUsageLast30dKb
  WRONG:   DataUsageLast30d (missing unit)
- Non-Mou duration columns: check magnitude
    max > 100,000 → append Secs
    max < 100,000 → append Mins
telecom_knowledge.period_rules:
Time Period Suffix Rules:
- If a column is period-specific (covers last 30, 60, 90 days etc), ALWAYS include the period in the name.
- Period suffix format: Last30d, Last60d, Last90d, Prev30d
- Place the period suffix BEFORE the unit suffix if both apply.
  CORRECT: DataUsageLast30dKb, RevenueLast60d, MouOutgoingLast30d
  WRONG:   DataUsageKbLast30d, RevenueLast60Days, MouOutgoing30
- If the column has no period context (e.g. a static demographic), do NOT add a period suffix.
  CORRECT: AgeYears, Gender, TenureDays, ActivationDate
  WRONG:   AgeYearsLast30d
telecom_knowledge.date_rules:
Date Field Detection Rules:
- Integer columns whose name contains: date, dt, dob, join, activ, deactiv, birth → almost always YYYYMMDD integers
- 8-digit integers between 19000101 and 20991231 → YYYYMMDD date format
- 6-digit integers → YYYYMM format
- Rename to clearly show it is a date: ActivationDate, BirthDate, DeactivationDate
- Do NOT convert the values — renaming only. Conversion is a later agent's job.
telecom_knowledge.naming_style_rules:
Naming Style Rules — apply to every column:
1. Use UpperCamelCase (PascalCase) for all names.
2. Balanced length — full words for things a junior data scientist would not know, short for universally understood terms.
   KEEP SHORT:  Mou, Arpu, Vas, Sms, Msisdn, Intl, Offnet, Onnet, Kb, Mb, Avg
   ALWAYS EXPAND: gndr→Gender, rgn→Region, aon→AgeOnNetwork, rchg→Recharge, actv→Activation, seg→Segment
3. Word order: [Metric][Direction][Period][Unit]
   CORRECT: MouOutgoingLast30d, DataUsageLast60dKb, RechargeAmountLast30d
   WRONG:   Last30dMouOutgoing, KbDataUsageLast60d
4. No underscores except inside period tokens (Last30d is one token, not Last_30_d).
5. No special characters, no spaces.
telecom_knowledge.target_schema:
Standard Churn Model Target Schema — match these names exactly when a column clearly maps to one:
IDENTIFIERS:  CustomerId, Msisdn, AccountId
DEMOGRAPHICS: AgeYears, Gender, Region, City, Nationality, MaritalStatus, Segment
TENURE:       TenureDays, TenureMonths, ActivationDate, DeactivationDate, ContractType
REVENUE:      ArpuMonthly, RevenueLast30d, RevenueLast60d, RevenueLast90d, TotalRevenue
VOICE:        MouOutgoingLast30d, MouIncomingLast30d, MouOffnetLast30d, MouOnnetLast30d, MouIntlLast30d
DATA:         DataUsageLast30dKb, DataUsageLast60dKb, DataRechargeCountLast30d
SMS:          SmsOutgoingLast30d, SmsIncomingLast30d
RECHARGES:    RechargeAmountLast30d, RechargeCountLast30d, DaysSinceLastRecharge
VAS:          VasSubCount, VasRevenueLast30d
COMPLAINTS:   ComplaintCountLast90d, DaysSinceLastComplaint, CustCareCallsLast30d
PRODUCT:      ProductCount, HandsetAgeMonths, DataPlanFlag, RoamingFlag
TARGET:       ChurnFlag (1=churned, 0=active)
